why: The one statement of the durable-wallpaper reference rule. bin/vshell_helper.py owns it as portable_ref and resolve_path; quickshell/vshell/Common/Paths.qml mirrors it for session.json, which the shell writes without the helper. scripts/check-vshell-helper.py and scripts/test-wallpaper-refs.js each run their own side against these rows, so the two implementations cannot drift apart without one of them going red.

ref.why: a built-in package's background under the running root becomes a rooted reference
anything else under the root is rooted too, such as the branding image a hook falls back to
a user package does not move with the shell, so its background stays absolute
a package background recorded by a checkout that is gone is re-rooted on this installation
a picture the user chose outside VGS names no package and is left alone
a system wallpaper outside both roots is left alone
the colour literal setWallpaperColor stores in the same field is not a path
a reference already in reference form is recorded unchanged

resolve.why: a rooted reference resolves against the root the shell is running from
a home-relative reference, the form target destinations are written in, resolves too
an absolute path is already resolved
no reference resolves to no path
